qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High pricing power on sole-source radar and sensor components (Eurofighter, TRML-4D, airborne electronic warfare) for Western defense platforms.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet). Premier German defense sensor, radar, and optronics specialist, but fails Gate 6 due to debt-funded M&A (ESG Group acquisition driving net debt to ~€650M+) and heavy working capital absorption during defense production ramp-ups.
qualitative.evidence: High-spec defense sensor provider with strong Eurofighter and air defense exposure. However, 2024 ESG Group acquisition increased net debt to ~€650M-€700M, and FCF dropped to €112M under intensive working capital requirements, while GAAP ROIC remains constrained around 10-11%.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
